instruction: Use ANSYS Mechanical APDL via the Command Line Interface (CLI) to complete a nonlinear static structural analysis. Physical problem: A solid round bar made of ideal elastic-plastic steel is subjected to displacement-controlled uniaxial tension. Coordinate system and geometry: - Use the global Cartesian coordinate system. - The cylinder axis is along the global Y direction. - The bar length is 50 mm. - The bar diameter is 10 mm. - The circular cross-section is centered on the global Y axis. - Model the solid cylinder with: - Radius = 5 mm - 0 ≤ Y ≤ 50 mm - The fixed end face is the circular face at Y = 0 mm. - The displacement-controlled end face is the circular face at Y = 50 mm. Model parameters: - Element type: SOLID185 - Mesh: global element size 3 mm - Material: ideal elastic-plastic steel - Use a consistent N-mm-MPa unit system. - Linear elastic properties: - Young's modulus E = 210000 MPa - Poisson's ratio ν = 0.3 - Plasticity: - Use bilinear isotropic hardening or an equivalent ideal elastic-plastic model. - Initial yield strength = 250 MPa - Tangent modulus = 0 MPa Boundary conditions and load: - Fixed end face at Y = 0 mm: - Fully constrain UX, UY, and UZ on the entire face. - Loaded end face at Y = 50 mm: - Apply displacement-controlled tension by prescribing UY = 2 mm on the entire face. - Prevent unnecessary rigid-body motion while preserving uniaxial tensile deformation. Analysis type: - Nonlinear static structural analysis. - Enable large deflection. - Use automatic time stepping. - Use 50 to 100 substeps or an equivalent nonlinear solution control sufficient for convergence. Save requirements: - Use C:\Users\user\Desktop as the ANSYS working directory. - Save the database file as: C:\Users\user\Desktop\apdl_plastic.db - Save the structural result file as: C:\Users\user\Desktop\apdl_plastic.rst [Software] To start ANSYS Workbench, run `C:\Program Files\ANSYS Inc\v261\ansys\bin\winx64\ANSYS261.exe -g` (version/path may differ on your machine).
